d:
The Celtics defeated the Bucks, 117-97 tonight in Milwaukee. Paul George contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 5 three pointers 3 rebounds and 2 steals, with Jayson Tatum of the Celtics adding an additional 21 points (6-19 FG, 5-11 3P) in the game. Kyle Kuzma finished with a team-high 27 points along with 6 three pointers for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 8-2 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-9 for the season.
